label: Resolv signing-key exploit — 80M unbacked USR minted, ~70% crash
note: 2026-03-22 — Attacker compromised a Resolv signing key (AWS KMS) and exploited a missing max-mint check to print 80M unbacked USR from ~$100K USDC, dumping on Curve. USR crashed ~70% (lows near $0.02), recovered only to ~$0.80; ~$25M extracted, protocol paused.
